reasoning: The question asks whether the primary credit discount rate will increase between March 15 and March 22, 2026. The Fed's next meeting is March 17-18, 2026. Evidence shows the Fed held rates at 3.50-3.75% in January 2026, with most economists expecting rate cuts (not increases) later in 2026. The primary credit rate is set relative to the federal funds rate target. Given the Fed is in a pause/potential cutting mode with no indication of rate hikes, and any March meeting change would likely be a cut or hold, an increase in the discount rate is extremely unlikely.
